tools.name: search_leads
tools.description: Find job vacancies and freelance orders. Returns the best few in a compact form, newest or best first, with a next_offset to page on; call get_lead_details for the full text and contacts of the ones that fit. Narrow with market, remote, since and skills instead of reading many pages.

tools.name: get_lead_details
tools.description: Full text, contacts (when the caller may see them), source and budget of one lead.

tools.name: get_market_analytics
tools.description: Top requested skills and the median budget over the latest 200 visible leads.
